name: Lust Harem 1001 Pleasures
storyline:
Framed during your own coronation, you are cast aside by your disappointed father and sent to a forsaken province where the former ruler has perished. Here, you must prove your worth and reclaim your place in the world.
At your side stands Selina, loyal and supportive, while a cunning priest watches your every step, waiting for a chance to see you fail. Upon arriving at the fallen lord’s mansion, you discover not only ruins of authority but also two enchanting women from his harem. Having survived the tragedy, they kept the province in balance — and now, they may become your weakness… or your greatest strength.
summary: Framed at your coronation and exiled to a fallen province, you must rebuild power, uncover desire, and forge a harem of loyalty and passion. Outsmart betrayal, seduce allies, and prove you can rule with both strength and pleasure.
